swap.label: Swap
swap.line: Two 2 x 2 patches of your half trade places

manifest.label: Manifest
manifest.line: Turns up to 3 junk or holes in a 3 x 3 into gems of the colour you pick, or the one most round them

scan.label: Scan
scan.line: Shows the aberrant's next skill and puts it off 2 turns

lift.label: Lift
lift.line: Lifts a row or a column of your half and sets it down shifted

herd.label: Herd
herd.line: Gems of one colour within 2 of the row or column you draw come onto it

transmute.label: Transmute
transmute.line: Every gem of one colour on your half turns to another, and none of the old colour falls for 2 turns

miracle.label: Miracle
miracle.line: One colour's gems on your half clear at any 2 touching, this turn and your next

kindle.label: Kindle
kindle.line: Lights every junk in a row or column of your half into an ember, and each cools into a gem at your turn's end

absorb.label: Absorb
absorb.line: Drinks every junk and slime in a 3 x 3 off your half; each gives 3 to your pool
